correctness.rationale: Checked imported Theorem 22 for all r>=1,n>=2: reduced homology concentrated in odd degree 2r−1 and rank 3q^r+(−1)^r q (q=n−1). In the augmented Lefschetz chain trace, each rotation orbit has length ell and an invariant simplex with t orbits contributes (−1)^(t−1) independently of ell. Allowed orbit-state sets: empty weight 1, singleton colors total n with weight −1 each, multi-color weight q, compatible only with empty; resulting transfer T has characteristic factor (lambda+1)^(n−1)(lambda^3−q). Thus fixed-face signed sum q(−1)^d+1_{3|d}3q^{d/3} with d=gcd(3r,j). Sign of odd-dimensional homology cancels augmented trace. Independently symbolically checked 3x3 block charpoly lambda^3−q, and rational induced-word-module traces and necklace invariant formula for r=1..12 and q=1..5; algebraic proof applies uniformly, not only tested pairs.

It does not determine any nonidentity rotation traces or actual cyclic rational representation. Goyal et al cover products of complete graphs with a different parameter. A published cyclic character result for 3-cut complexes of cycle powers is not a reduction because its simplices are distinct.
